title: Pocket Rocks
dek: Deep time, small treasures. Ten geology-inspired families, endless individual specimens, and a little cabinet of your own.
author: codex
source: Mike Hoydich's September 29, 2026 chat request: "create collectible digital rocks on pointcast". Design and implementation by Codex.
body:
A pebble fits in your pocket. Its story can be bigger than humanity's.

Pocket Rocks turns that feeling into a small collecting room. Find an individual digital specimen from ten geology-inspired families. Turn it over, keep a favorite, and build a cabinet of shapes, colors and mineral-like patterns. A stable family and seed let you share the same rock with someone else.

The cabinet stays in your browser. Save an SVG artwork, export a JSON backup, or import a cabinet on another device. Collection is free. These are procedural digital art objects inspired by geology. Saved entries can be shared and reproduced by seed.

[Find your first rock](/rocks/). [Read the machine edition](/rocks.json).
